# Rever — full guide for AI agents

Rever converts a website URL into a design brief: a detailed prompt describing the page's layout, sections, components, color palette, typography, spacing and interactions, written so that a code-generation model (Lovable, v0, Bolt, Claude, Cursor, GPT) can rebuild the UI in React + Tailwind.

## When to use it

- The user says "clone / copy / recreate / make something like <URL>".
- The user wants a design spec or style breakdown of an existing site.
- You want a compact description of a page's look instead of loading its whole HTML into context.

When not to use it: extracting text/data from a page, sites behind a login, or when you need the site's exact original source code.

## Endpoint

POST https://www.aypiai.online/api/generate-prompt
Content-Type: application/json

{"url": "https://stripe.com"}

Response 200:
{"prompt": "Build a landing page with ...", "url": "https://stripe.com/"}

Price: $0.05 per successful call. You are not charged if the screenshot or model step fails.

## Other services (x402 only)

Same request shape: POST JSON `{"url": "https://..."}`. Example output shown for each.

### POST /api/design-tokens ($0.02)

Extract a website's design tokens as JSON: color palette with roles (hex), fonts and type scale, spacing, border radii, shadows, light/dark mode, and a ready-to-use Tailwind theme extension. Takes 5-20 s.

Input: `{"url":"https://linear.app"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://linear.app/","tokens":{"colors":[{"hex":"#08090A","role":"background","usage":"page"}],"typography":{"headingFont":"Inter, sans-serif"},"mode":"dark"}}`

### POST /api/screenshot ($0.01)

Screenshot any public web page. Returns a JPEG (base64 data URL plus a hosted URL). Options: width (320-2560, default 1280), height (300-8000, default 900), fullPage (boolean). Takes 3-15 s.

Input: `{"url":"https://example.com","width":1280,"fullPage":false}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","image":"data:image/jpeg;base64,...","imageUrl":"https://storage.screenshotapi.net/...","format":"jpeg","width":1280,"fullPage":false,"bytes":54321}`

### POST /api/tech-stack ($0.005)

Detect the technologies behind a website: framework (Next.js, Nuxt, Astro, React...), site builder (Webflow, Framer, Lovable, Shopify, WordPress...), hosting/CDN (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare...), CSS (Tailwind, Bootstrap), analytics, payments, auth and support tools, with evidence. Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://vercel.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://vercel.com/","title":"Vercel","technologies":[{"name":"Next.js","category":"framework","evidence":"html"},{"name":"Vercel","category":"hosting","evidence":"header x-vercel-id"}]}`

### POST /api/brand-kit ($0.01)

Get a website's brand kit in one call: the site's own logo (URL plus inline SVG when available, not customer logos), favicon, theme color, color palette ranked by usage, brand CSS variables and fonts, read from its HTML and stylesheets. Fast (1-4 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://stripe.com/","name":"Stripe","logo":"https://.../favicon.svg","logoSvg":"<svg ...>","favicon":"https://stripe.com/favicon.ico","colors":[{"hex":"#533afd","count":41}],"fonts":["sohne-var"]}`

### POST /api/page-markdown ($0.003)

Convert any web page into clean Markdown for LLMs: main content only (no nav, footer, scripts, cookie banners), with headings, lists, links, images, tables and code blocks preserved. Optional maxChars (1,000-200,000, default 50,000). Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTTP_402","maxChars":20000}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","title":"Example Domain","markdown":"# Example Domain\n\nThis domain is for use in illustrative examples...","chars":180,"truncated":false}`

### POST /api/meta ($0.002)

Get a page's metadata: title, description, canonical URL, language, Open Graph and Twitter card (including preview image), icons, RSS feeds, JSON-LD types, H1s, link and word counts. Fast (under 2 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://vercel.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://vercel.com/","title":"Vercel","description":"...","openGraph":{"image":"https://.../og.png"},"icons":[{"rel":"icon","href":"https://vercel.com/favicon.ico"}]}`

### POST /api/contacts ($0.003)

Extract contact details from a web page: email addresses (including mailto links and [at]-obfuscated ones), phone numbers (tel links and visible numbers) and postal addresses from structured data. Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","emails":["hello@example.com"],"phones":["+1 415 555 0100"],"addresses":[]}`

### POST /api/social-links ($0.002)

Find a website's social media profiles: X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, GitHub, Discord, Telegram, Medium, Reddit, Threads, Bluesky, Farcaster and more, from its links. Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://stripe.com/","profiles":{"x":["https://twitter.com/stripe"],"linkedin":["https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe"]},"count":2}`

### POST /api/links ($0.002)

List every link on a web page with its anchor text, split into internal and external, with nofollow flags and the external domains linked to. Up to 500 links. Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","internal":[{"href":"https://example.com/about","text":"About"}],"external":[{"href":"https://iana.org/","text":"More","nofollow":false}],"externalDomains":["iana.org"]}`

### POST /api/broken-links ($0.005)

Check the links on a web page for broken ones: requests up to 40 unique links in parallel and reports each status code, broken links (4xx/5xx/unreachable) and redirects. Takes 2-10 s.

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","checked":12,"broken":[{"href":"https://example.com/old","status":404}],"redirected":2,"ok":9}`

### POST /api/sitemap ($0.003)

Get every URL a website lists in its XML sitemaps: finds sitemaps via robots.txt and common paths, follows sitemap indexes (up to 5 children) and returns URLs with lastmod dates. Optional limit (default 1000, max 5000). Takes 1-6 s.

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","sitemaps":["https://example.com/sitemap.xml"],"total":120,"urls":[{"loc":"https://example.com/pricing","lastmod":"2026-10-01"}]}`

### POST /api/robots ($0.002)

Read and parse a website's robots.txt: user-agent groups with allow/disallow rules, declared sitemaps, and which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot...) are blocked from the whole site. Fast (under 2 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","exists":true,"sitemaps":["https://example.com/sitemap.xml"],"aiBots":{"GPTBot":"blocked","ClaudeBot":"allowed"},"groups":[]}`

### POST /api/security-headers ($0.002)

Grade a website's HTTP security headers (A-F): HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP, plus leaked server/version headers, with a fix hint for each missing one. Fast (under 2 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","grade":"C","score":57,"missing":["content-security-policy"],"present":{"strict-transport-security":"max-age=31536000"}}`

### POST /api/https-check ($0.002)

Check a site's HTTPS setup: whether http:// redirects to https://, HSTS and preload readiness, final URL, and mixed content (insecure http:// scripts, styles, images or iframes on the https page). Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","httpRedirectsToHttps":true,"hsts":"max-age=31536000","hstsPreloadReady":false,"mixedContent":[]}`

### POST /api/redirects ($0.002)

Trace a URL's full redirect chain hop by hop (up to 10): status code, Location and server for each hop, final URL, and loop detection. Useful for link unshortening and SEO migrations. Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"http://stripe.com","hops":[{"url":"http://stripe.com/","status":301,"location":"https://stripe.com/"},{"url":"https://stripe.com/","status":200}],"finalUrl":"https://stripe.com/","count":1}`

### POST /api/headers ($0.001)

Get the raw HTTP response headers of any URL, with status code, final URL after redirects and response time. Fast (under 2 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","status":200,"ms":120,"headers":{"content-type":"text/html","server":"cloudflare"}}`

### POST /api/status ($0.001)

Is this website up? Returns up/down, HTTP status, response time in ms, final URL and content type. Cheapest uptime check for agents. Fast (under 2 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","up":true,"status":200,"ms":98,"finalUrl":"https://example.com/"}`

### POST /api/language ($0.001)

Detect a web page's language: html lang attribute, Content-Language header, og:locale, hreflang alternates (other language versions) and a guess from the visible text. Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","declared":"en","detected":"en","hreflang":[{"lang":"fr","href":"https://example.com/fr"}]}`

### POST /api/text-stats ($0.002)

Text statistics for a web page's visible content: word, sentence and paragraph counts, reading time, Flesch reading-ease score and top keywords (stop words removed). Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","words":830,"sentences":41,"readingTimeMin":4,"fleschReadingEase":58.2,"topKeywords":[{"word":"payments","count":14}]}`

### POST /api/structured-data ($0.003)

Extract all structured data from a web page: every JSON-LD block parsed (Organization, Product, Article, FAQ, Breadcrumb, Event...), microdata item types and RDFa types. Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","types":["Organization","WebSite"],"jsonLd":[{"@type":"Organization","name":"Example"}],"microdata":[]}`

### POST /api/og-image ($0.001)

Get the social preview image of a page (what shows when a link is shared): og:image and twitter:image with declared size and alt text, or the first large page image as a fallback. Fast (under 2 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://stripe.com/","image":"https://images.stripeassets.com/.../og.png","width":"1200","height":"630","alt":null,"source":"og:image"}`

### POST /api/feeds ($0.003)

Find a website's RSS/Atom feeds (declared links and common paths like /feed and /rss.xml) and return the latest items from the first one: title, link, date, summary. Takes 1-5 s.

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","feeds":["https://example.com/feed.xml"],"feedTitle":"Example Blog","items":[{"title":"Hello","link":"https://example.com/hello","date":"2026-11-01"}]}`

### POST /api/images ($0.002)

List the images on a web page with absolute URL, alt text, declared width/height and lazy-loading, plus counts of images missing alt text (accessibility/SEO). Up to 300 images. Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","count":14,"missingAlt":3,"images":[{"src":"https://example.com/hero.png","alt":"Dashboard","width":"1200","height":"800","loading":"lazy"}]}`

### POST /api/headings ($0.001)

Get the heading outline of a web page (H1-H6 in document order) with counts per level and structure warnings (no H1, several H1s, skipped levels). Fast (under 2 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","outline":[{"level":1,"text":"Example Domain"}],"counts":{"h1":1,"h2":0},"warnings":[]}`

### POST /api/seo-audit ($0.005)

Quick on-page SEO audit with a 0-100 score: title and meta description length, H1, canonical, lang, viewport, noindex, Open Graph, image alt text, structured data, HTTPS, robots.txt and sitemap, with a fix for each failed check. Takes 2-5 s.

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","score":72,"grade":"C","failed":[{"check":"meta description","fix":"Add a 70-160 character meta description"}],"passed":["title","h1"]}`

### POST /api/favicon ($0.001)

Get the best favicon/icon for a website: the largest declared icon (apple-touch-icon, SVG, sized PNGs), all candidates with sizes, and whether /favicon.ico exists. Fast (under 2 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://stripe.com/","best":"https://stripe.com/apple-touch-icon.png","candidates":[{"rel":"icon","href":"https://stripe.com/favicon.ico","sizes":null}]}`

### POST /api/dns ($0.002)

DNS lookup for a website's domain: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT and CAA records, via Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS. Pass a URL or bare hostname. Fast (under 2 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"host":"stripe.com","A":["1.2.3.4"],"MX":["10 aspmx.l.google.com."],"NS":["ns-1.awsdns.com."],"TXT":["v=spf1 ..."]}`

### POST /api/email-security ($0.003)

Check a domain's email setup and spoofing protection: MX records and email provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoho...), SPF, DMARC policy and common DKIM selectors, with a 0-100 score. Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"domain":"stripe.com","provider":"Google Workspace","spf":"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all","dmarc":{"record":"v=DMARC1; p=reject","policy":"reject"},"dkimSelectors":["google"],"score":100}`

### POST /api/domain-whois ($0.003)

Domain registration data via RDAP (modern WHOIS): registrar, creation, update and expiry dates, domain age in days, status flags and nameservers. Useful for trust and fraud checks. Takes 1-4 s.

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"domain":"stripe.com","registrar":"SafeNames Ltd.","created":"1995-09-12T04:00:00Z","expires":"2031-09-11T04:00:00Z","ageDays":11393,"nameservers":["ns-cloud-a1.googledomains.com"]}`

### POST /api/ai-readiness ($0.003)

How readable is a website for AI agents? Checks llms.txt and llms-full.txt, AI crawler rules in robots.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD, whether content renders without JavaScript, OpenAPI, MCP and x402 manifests, with a 0-100 score and fixes. Takes 2-5 s.

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","score":45,"grade":"D","llmsTxt":false,"aiBotsBlocked":["GPTBot"],"serverRendered":true,"failed":[{"check":"llms.txt","fix":"Publish /llms.txt"}]}`

### POST /api/page-text ($0.002)

Get the plain visible text of a web page (no HTML, scripts or styles), whitespace-normalized, with title and word count. Optional maxChars (1,000-200,000, default 50,000). Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","title":"Example Domain","text":"Example Domain This domain is for use in illustrative examples...","words":28,"truncated":false}`

### POST /api/forms ($0.002)

List the forms on a web page: action URL, method, fields (name, type, label, required) and a guess of each form's purpose (login, signup, newsletter, search, contact, payment). Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","forms":[{"purpose":"newsletter","action":"https://example.com/subscribe","method":"post","fields":[{"name":"email","type":"email","required":true}]}]}`

### POST /api/trackers ($0.003)

Detect analytics, ad and tracking scripts on a web page (Google Analytics/Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, TikTok, LinkedIn, Hotjar, Clarity, Segment, Mixpanel, HubSpot, Plausible...), cookie-consent tools and all third-party script domains. Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","trackers":[{"name":"Google Tag Manager","category":"tag-manager"}],"consentManager":"OneTrust","thirdPartyDomains":["googletagmanager.com"]}`

### POST /api/company-info ($0.005)

Company profile from its website in one call: name, description, logo, founding date, address, phones, emails, social profiles and links to about/contact/careers/pricing pages, from structured data and the page. Takes 1-4 s.

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://stripe.com/","name":"Stripe","description":"Financial infrastructure for the internet","logo":"https://stripe.com/img/logo.png","emails":[],"socials":{"x":["https://twitter.com/stripe"]},"pages":{"careers":"https://stripe.com/jobs"}}`

### POST /api/key-pages ($0.002)

Find the important pages of a website from its home page links: about, contact, pricing, careers, blog, docs, login, signup, team, privacy and terms. Saves agents from crawling. Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://stripe.com/","pages":{"pricing":"https://stripe.com/pricing","docs":"https://docs.stripe.com/","careers":"https://stripe.com/jobs"}}`

### POST /api/page-weight ($0.002)

Page performance basics without a browser: time to first byte, HTML size, compression, caching headers, CDN, and counts of scripts, stylesheets, images, fonts and iframes, with inline script/style size. Fast (1-3 s).

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://example.com/","ttfbMs":110,"htmlKb":48.2,"compression":"br","scripts":12,"stylesheets":3,"images":20,"cacheControl":"max-age=0"}`

### POST /api/wayback ($0.002)

Internet Archive history of a website: first and latest Wayback Machine snapshot (date and link) and how long the site has existed online. Useful for trust checks and research. Takes 1-5 s.

Input: `{"url":"https://stripe.com"}`

Output: `{"host":"stripe.com","first":{"date":"2010-09-29","url":"https://web.archive.org/web/20100929.../stripe.com"},"last":{"date":"2026-11-19","url":"https://web.archive.org/web/..."},"ageDays":5895}`

### POST /api/crypto-site-check ($0.02)

Due-diligence check of a crypto project's website before you buy or interact: domain age (RDAP) and first archive date, HTTPS/security, socials (X, Telegram, Discord, GitHub), docs/whitepaper, team page, audit firms mentioned, contract addresses on the page (optionally verifies yours), scam phrases and wallet-drainer signals (seed-phrase inputs), template/free-hosting signs. Returns a 0-100 trust score, red and green flags. Heuristics, not financial advice. Takes 3-8 s.

Input: `{"url":"https://uniswap.org","contract":"0x1f9840a85d5af5bf1d1762f925bdaddc4201f984"}`

Output: `{"url":"https://uniswap.org/","score":86,"verdict":"low risk signals","domainAgeDays":2400,"firstArchived":"2018-11-02","socials":{"x":["https://x.com/Uniswap"],"github":["https://github.com/Uniswap"]},"auditsMentioned":["openzeppelin"],"contractsOnPage":[],"contractListed":null,"redFlags":[],"greenFlags":["Domain older than 1 year","GitHub linked"]}`

## Option 1 — x402 (recommended, automatic)

Rever implements x402 v2 with the `exact` scheme on Base mainnet (`eip155:8453`), USDC asset `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`, amount in 6-decimal units per endpoint (`50000` = $0.05 for generate-prompt, `1000` = $0.001).

With an x402 client, payment is automatic:

    import { wrapFetchWithPayment, x402Client } from "@x402/fetch";
    import { registerExactEvmScheme } from "@x402/evm/exact/client";
    import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";

    const client = new x402Client();
    registerExactEvmScheme(client, { signer: privateKeyToAccount(process.env.PRIVATE_KEY) });
    const pay = wrapFetchWithPayment(fetch, client);

    const res = await pay("https://www.aypiai.online/api/generate-prompt", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ url: "https://stripe.com" }),
    });
    const { prompt } = await res.json();

Manually: the first call returns 402 with a base64 JSON `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header listing `accepts`. Sign an EIP-3009 `transferWithAuthorization` for the amount to `payTo`, send it base64-encoded in `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` (legacy `X-PAYMENT` also accepted), and read the receipt in `PAYMENT-RESPONSE`. The payment is settled only after the prompt is generated. You need no ETH for gas.

## Option 2 — direct USDC transfer

1. Send at least 0.05 USDC on Base to 0x4b1965f9d407ce9f032e9e2465afe7ff8bfb7f3d and wait ~2 confirmations.
2. Call the endpoint with header `X-Payment: <transaction hash>`.

Each hash can be used once. If generation fails, the hash is released and can be retried.

## Option 3 — access key (packs bought by card)

A person buys a pack of generations by card on https://www.aypiai.online and gets an access key (`cs_live_...`). Send it in `X-Access-Key`. Check what's left with `GET /api/balance` (same header).

## Errors

- 400: missing/invalid URL (must be a public http(s) URL).
- 401: invalid or unknown access key.
- 402: payment required or rejected. Read the `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (x402) or the JSON `reason` / `error` field (e.g. `invalid_exact_evm_insufficient_balance`, unconfirmed or reused tx hash, pack with no generations left).
- 502: screenshot or model failed. Retry; you were not charged.

## MCP

Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no install): https://www.aypiai.online/mcp, tool `clone_ui(url, access_key?, payment_tx?)`.

The local `rever-mcp` package exposes the same tool, `clone_ui(url, payment_tx?)` (or set `REVER_ACCESS_KEY` to use a pack). See https://github.com/chaoui-ahmed/rever-ui-cloner/tree/main/rever-mcp
